MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "A Pentatonix Christmas combines Christmas songs with vocal harmonies, which fits my holiday listening and feels like something new I would choose.",
    "The Very Best Of Nat King Cole appeals to my interest in familiar classic vocals, while It's Entertainment feels worth considering after The New Old Fashioned."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Country hits and rain sounds do not serve my current interest in holiday songs and vocal music.",
    "Life and His Love Remains give me too little indication of a musical match to motivate me to try them.",
    "The Classic Christmas Album fits my taste, but its familiar title gives me little reason to choose it again today."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in music seems to have been stretched too broadly to include recordings with little connection to the songs and vocals I want.",
    "A seasonal connection alone is not enough: Advent At Ephesus interests me, but I am unsure about choosing a devotional recording."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I want a fresh choice that preserves the combination of Christmas songs and appealing vocals, rather than another familiar album title.",
    "Something can fit my taste without being something I would choose now; classic vocals and related entertainment albums are less compelling this visit than a new holiday album."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in holiday and vocal music, but missed how strongly I prefer a fresh holiday choice over broader musical matches or familiar titles."
}
